# Chart values

For: admins who install harbor-operator with its Helm chart.

<!-- Generated by `make generate` from deploy/charts/harbor-operator/values.yaml. Do not edit. -->

| Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `replicaCount` | `1` | Number of operator replicas. Leader election keeps one of them active. |
| `image.repository` | `ghcr.io/soliddowant/harbor-operator` | Operator image repository. |
| `image.tag` | `""` | Image tag. Defaults to the chart's appVersion. |
| `image.pullPolicy` | `IfNotPresent` | Image pull policy. |
| `imagePullSecrets` | `[]` | Names of image pull Secrets. |
| `nameOverride` | `""` | Override the chart name used in resource names. |
| `fullnameOverride` | `""` | Override the full resource name. |
| `crds.install` | `true` | Install the CRDs with the chart. Set to false when you manage them yourself. |
| `serviceAccount.create` | `true` | Create the ServiceAccount. |
| `serviceAccount.name` | `""` | ServiceAccount name. Defaults to the full name. |
| `serviceAccount.annotations` | `{}` | Annotations for the ServiceAccount. |
| `leaderElection.enabled` | `true` | Enable leader election. |
| `watchNamespaces` | `[]` | Namespaces that the operator watches. Empty means all namespaces. See docs/admin/install.md. |
| `metrics.port` | `8443` | Port of the metrics endpoint. |
| `metrics.secure` | `true` | Serve metrics over HTTPS with authentication and authorization. |
| `metrics.reader.enabled` | `false` | Create a ClusterRole that allows `get` on `/metrics`, and bind it to `subjects`. The secure metrics endpoint needs this for each scraper. Needs `metrics.secure`. |
| `metrics.reader.subjects` | `[]` | Service accounts that may read the metrics. Each item has `namespace` and `name`. |
| `metrics.vmServiceScrape.enabled` | `false` | Create a VictoriaMetrics `VMServiceScrape` for the metrics Service. Needs `metrics.secure`. |
| `metrics.vmServiceScrape.interval` | `""` | Scrape interval. Leave empty for the scraper's default. |
| `metrics.vmServiceScrape.caFile` | `""` | CA bundle file in the scraper pod that verifies the serving certificate. Leave empty to skip verification, because the certificate is self-signed. |
| `metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled` | `false` | Create a Prometheus Operator `ServiceMonitor` for the metrics Service. Needs `metrics.secure`. |
| `metrics.serviceMonitor.interval` | `""` | Scrape interval. Leave empty for the scraper's default. |
| `metrics.serviceMonitor.caFile` | `""` | CA bundle file in the scraper pod that verifies the serving certificate. Leave empty to skip verification, because the certificate is self-signed. |
| `grafanaDashboard.configMap.enabled` | `false` | Render a ConfigMap with the dashboard for Grafana's dashboard sidecar. |
| `grafanaDashboard.configMap.labels` | `""` | Labels on the dashboard ConfigMap. The sidecar selects ConfigMaps by this label. |
| `grafanaDashboard.grafanaOperator.enabled` | `false` | Render a grafana-operator GrafanaDashboard with the dashboard inline. |
| `grafanaDashboard.grafanaOperator.allowCrossNamespaceImport` | `false` | Let grafana-operator import the dashboard into a Grafana instance in another namespace. Set it to true when the operator does not run in the namespace of the Grafana instance. |
| `grafanaDashboard.grafanaOperator.instanceSelector` | `{}` | Selects the Grafana instances that get the dashboard. Required when the Grafana operator dashboard is enabled: `helm template` fails without it. There is no default label, and your selector is used as you write it. |
| `resources.requests.cpu` | `10m` | CPU request. There is no CPU limit. |
| `resources.requests.memory` | `128Mi` | Memory request. |
| `resources.limits.memory` | `128Mi` | Memory limit. Keep it equal to the memory request. |
| `extraArgs` | `[]` | Extra arguments for the operator binary. |
| `podAnnotations` | `{}` | Pod annotations. |
| `podLabels` | `{}` | Extra labels on the operator pod, for example to match a network policy. They are added to the selector labels, which stay the same. |
| `nodeSelector` | `{}` | Node selector. |
| `tolerations` | `[]` | Tolerations. |
| `affinity` | `{}` | Affinity rules. |
| `networkPolicy.enabled` | `false` | Create a NetworkPolicy that limits egress to the API server, Harbor and DNS. |
| `networkPolicy.apiServer.cidrs` | `[]` | CIDRs of the Kubernetes API server (the `kubernetes` Service IP and the control plane node IPs). Required when the policy is enabled. |
| `networkPolicy.apiServer.ports` | `[443, 6443]` | Ports of the API server. |
| `networkPolicy.harborEgress.peers` | `[]` | Where Harbor is. A list of NetworkPolicy peers: `ipBlock`, or `podSelector` with `namespaceSelector`. Leave empty to allow any destination on the Harbor ports. |
| `networkPolicy.harborEgress.ports` | `[443]` | Ports of the Harbor URL. |
| `networkPolicy.dns.namespaceLabels` | `""` | Labels of the namespace that runs the cluster DNS. |
| `networkPolicy.dns.podLabels` | `""` | Labels of the cluster DNS pods. |
| `podDisruptionBudget.enabled` | `false` | Create a PodDisruptionBudget. |
| `podDisruptionBudget.maxUnavailable` | `1` | Number of pods that may be unavailable. |
